title: _rows_affected computed but unused
description: api.rs:1674. In delete_filter_v2(), the line 'let _rows_affected = if del_filter.is_some() { 1u64 } else { 0u64 };' computes a value that is immediately discarded by the underscore prefix. The conditional is also pointless since del_filter.is_some() was already checked at line 1668. The entire line is dead code.
